- **American**: Revenue $54,211M, Operating income $2,614M → margin ≈ 4.82%, and operating income *declined* from $3,034M in FY2023 [DOC-1: "American Airlines Group... Revenue FY2023 $52,788M, FY2024 $54,211M. Operating income FY2023 $3,034M, FY2024 $2,614M."]

**Conclusion:** Delta Air Lines posted the largest absolute revenue ($61,643M), the largest absolute operating income ($5,995M), and the highest operating margin (~9.73%) among the five carriers in FY2024, while also growing operating income year-over-year. ANSWER: Delta Air Lines was the strongest FY2024 performer among the five, based on having the highest revenue ($61,643M), highest operating income ($5,995M), and highest operating margin (~9.7%) of the group [DOC-1].
